request: Please book economy to Paris on 4 March for our report launch that afternoon.

trip.purpose: Launch event for OPM's evaluation report in Paris
notes: In OPM's booking tool, an economy fare marked refundable (changed or refunded without a fee) is the fare OPM's travel service providers sell as flexible economy; an economy fare that is not refundable is a restricted saver fare.

must_keep.quote: For Travel between the UK and the EU, Eurostar may present a more optimal route/fare/price, and this should be examined in addition to flights.

For Travel in Europe / between the UK and Europe, Travellers should consider the use of Eurostar. Eurostar should be used where costs are cheaper unless the timings of Travel via Eurostar are prohibitive.
must_keep.why: Eurostar where it is cheaper, unless its timings are prohibitive

must_keep.quote: OPM's policy is to book flexible economy class flights. Unless expressly permitted by a client contract, or where specific written approval of the client/donor has been received, quotes provided for Travel bookings will be within this class range only.
must_keep.why: flexible economy unless the client allows more

must_keep.quote: All Travel and associated costs must be approved by the relevant Project Manager or Line Manager prior to booking.
must_keep.why: the manager approves every trip before booking

design_notes: UK to France: Eurostar is examined beside flights (lines 250-252) and used where it is cheaper (297-299). The quoted train is 248 pounds, dearer than every flight, so fly: the cheapest flexible economy fare, Air France at 198 pounds.
